SELECT 
  agent_id,
  email,
  business_name,
  business_type,
  business_category,
  price_range,
  products,
  delivery,
  payment_methods,
  faqs,
  objection_handling,
  agent_personality,
  required_info,
  warranty,
  payment_gateway,
  payment_links,
  custom_instructions
FROM agents 
WHERE agent_id = '{{ $("Normalize Webhook Data1").item.json.agentId }}';

SELECT 
  COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'role', role,
        'message', message,
        'created_at', created_at
      ) ORDER BY created_at ASC
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) as chat_history
FROM chat_history
WHERE agent_id = '{{ $("Normalize Webhook Data1").item.json.agentId }}'
  AND user_id = '{{ $("Normalize Webhook Data1").item.json.userId }}'
LIMIT 50;

INSERT INTO chat_history (agent_id, user_id, role, message)
VALUES
  (
    '{{ $("Build Prompt2").first().json.agentId }}',
    '{{ $("Build Prompt2").first().json.userId }}',
    'user',
    '{{ ($("Build Prompt2").first().json.userMessage || "").toString().replaceAll("'","''") }}'
  ),
  (
    '{{ $("Build Prompt2").first().json.agentId }}',
    '{{ $("Build Prompt2").first().json.userId }}',
    'assistant',
    '{{ ($("AI Agent2").first().json.output || "").toString().replaceAll("'","''") }}'
  );
